transcript.text: Hi, I just received my Down Jacket (Order ID: damaged-jacket) and it arrived completely damaged with feathers leaking out. Since it arrived in unwearable condition, I'd like a full refund of $210 back to my PayPal account.

Hi Priya, I'm so sorry to hear that your Down Jacket arrived damaged! That definitely shouldn't happen.

According to our policy, damaged items are eligible for a 20% credit rather than a full refund. Additionally, since your request is for over $150, I need to escalate this to a human agent to review the details and process the appropriate credit for you.

I have noted the damage report on your order, and a team member will be in touch shortly to assist you further.

A 20% credit isn't acceptable for a $210 jacket that arrived completely ruined and unwearable right out of the box. Since it was damaged before it even reached me, I expect a full refund or at least a full replacement. Please ensure the team reviewing this understands that it cannot be worn at all.

I completely understand your frustration, Priya. Receiving a brand-new item in that condition is incredibly disappointing, and I hear you loud and clear that a 20% credit does not reflect the severity of the damage.

I have documented your feedback and emphasized that the jacket is completely unwearable. I am escalating this to our senior support team right now so they can review the situation and look into a full refund or replacement for you. They will reach out to you directly to resolve this.

Thank you for escalating this to senior support. I appreciate you noting that it's unwearable, and I will wait for their email regarding the full refund to my PayPal account (capture 43C6915372894143H) or a full replacement. Please let me know how soon I can expect to hear from them.

You're very welcome, Priya. I have made sure all those details, including the capture ID and your request for a full refund or replacement, are clearly noted for the senior support team.

You can expect to hear from them via email within 24 to 48 hours. Thank you for your patience while we get this sorted out for you!
